items.title: 메디웨일, 망막 기반 심혈관 위험 예측 AI '닥터눈 CVD' 미국 FDA 510(k) 허가
items.excerpt: 메디웨일의 망막 사진 기반 AI '닥터눈 CVD'가 FDA 510(k) 허가를 받았다. 안저 사진으로 10년 내 첫 죽상경화성 심혈관질환(ASCVD) 발생 위험을 추정해 위험 점수와 3단계 위험군을 제시하며, 회사는 미국 1차 의료기관 보급을 추진한다.

items.title: JW Pharmaceutical advances oral STAT6 inhibitor as global competition heats up
items.excerpt: JW Pharmaceutical's oral small-molecule STAT6 inhibitor for eosinophilic esophagitis, discovered on its AI drug-discovery platform JWave, was selected for Korea's national drug development program and enters preclinical development with 18 months of government support.

items.title: Rapid comparative evaluation of 2 ambient artificial intelligence applications in a learning health system
items.source: JAMIA (Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association)
items.excerpt: A learning-health-system evaluation compared two ambient AI scribes (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days using a cluster randomized crossover design plus EHR workflow outcomes and simulated encounters, measuring satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability and patient sentiment. (Off-list outlet: academic.oup.com; date from Crossref created.)

items.title: Validation of Computer Vision in the Operating Room for Ambient Documentation
items.excerpt: Stanford Health Care study in JAMA Surgery validates computer-vision ambient timestamp documentation (Aimbient) across a variety of operating-room procedures, reporting human-level accuracy for automated OR documentation. (Date from Crossref created; JAMA HTML behind Cloudflare.)

items.title: AI matches radiologists on prostate cancer MRI across 22 countries
items.excerpt: The SCARLET-1 study in Radiology analyzed 22,445 prostate MRI exams from 21,252 men at 46 sites in 22 countries; the AI system matched standard-of-care radiologist readings (83%-87.9% agreement across three external datasets). Check vs 2026-10-14 AuntMinnie prostate-MRI AI item for possible same-study overlap.

items.title: DKI may improve care in mild newborn HIE cases
items.excerpt: A machine-learning model combining diffusion kurtosis MRI with clinical data from 740 newborns at four hospitals predicted 24-month neurodevelopmental outcomes in mild hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy with AUC 0.92, beating clinical-only (0.85) or imaging-only (0.86) models (Radiology, Nov. 24). Pediatric brain MRI - note neuro-MRI saturation.

items.title: Predictive uncertainty representations in clinical AI shape physicians' advice uptake, accuracy, and trust
items.excerpt: 227 physicians assessed patient cases with an AI sepsis-type risk estimate shown with or without representations of the model's predictive uncertainty; how uncertainty was displayed changed how often doctors took the AI's advice, their accuracy and their trust.

items.title: Multimodal AI for bacterial vs viral upper respiratory tract infection multicentre development and internal validation
items.excerpt: A multimodal AI model fusing pharyngeal images with clinical data was developed and internally validated across multiple centres to distinguish Group A streptococcus pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory infections, aiming to guide appropriate antibiotic use.

items.title: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP
items.excerpt: The AI platform ORIDTP designs de novo dual-target therapeutic peptides, producing anti-obesity, antidiabetic and anticancer peptide candidates with strong in vivo efficacy. Disease-targeted preclinical drug design (science/medicine boundary - medicine per _note since diseases are specified).

items.title: How artificial intelligence is offering new hope for stroke patients in the Last Frontier
items.excerpt: In Alaska, a small network of hospitals is betting on AI tools to triage stroke patients and get them to the right care faster across vast distances. (Stroke imaging saturation 11-23 - deployment angle only.)

items.title: Samjin Pharm, Ontact Health launch AI-assisted echocardiography service
items.excerpt: Samjin Pharmaceutical and Ontact Health launched SoniX EchoPilot, an AI echocardiography service that auto-classifies images, selects optimal views, performs measurements and strain analysis, and returns specialist-reviewed reports to cut clinician workload and inter-examiner variability.

items.title: 숫자로 본 '니어닥' 6개월, 국내 진료실 'AI 차팅' 시대 본격 개막
items.excerpt: 스튜디오키코의 앰비언트 AI 스크라이브 '니어닥'이 출시 6개월 만에 563개 의료기관, 누적 114만 건 진료에 쓰였다. 의사 1인당 월평균 713건, 유료 전환율 74%이며, 의료진 120명 설문에서 차트 1건 작성 시간이 3분 48초에서 1분 8초로 약 70% 줄었다(회사 발표·설문 기반).

items.title: 조기위암 침윤 깊이 예측까지…웨이센 '웨이메드 엔도', AI 내시경 패러다임 전환 예고
items.excerpt: KDDW 2026에서 강남세브란스병원 연구진이 웨이센 AI 내시경 '웨이메드 엔도'로 조기위암의 침윤 깊이를 예측한 연구와 실사용 임상 경험을 발표했다. 내시경 절제와 수술 중 치료 방식을 가르는 지표를 AI가 뒷받침한다는 내용이다.

items.title: 일산백병원, 메디웨일 AI 안저 분석 시스템 '닥터눈' 전격 도입
items.excerpt: 인제대 일산백병원이 메디웨일의 AI 안저 영상 분석 솔루션 '닥터눈'을 진료 현장에 도입해 안과를 넘어 전신질환 위험 예측에 활용한다. (Same company as the 11-25 FDA 510(k) item - pick one.)

items.title: 서울백강병원, 간호·간병통합병동에 AI 모니터링 도입
items.excerpt: 서울백강병원이 간호·간병통합서비스 병동 30병상에 대웅제약·씨어스의 AI 환자 모니터링 '씽크'를 도입해 실시간 생체신호 관찰이 가능한 스마트병동 운영을 시작했다(간호 업무 부담 경감 목적, 성과 수치 없음).

items.title: '책임' 대신 '판단' 택한 의학한림원…"AI 책임은 함께 나눠야"
items.excerpt: 대한민국의학한림원이 의료 AI 활용 윤리 가이드라인 초안을 공개했다. 진단·치료의 최종 판단은 의료진에게 있다고 명시했지만 AI 사고 시 개발사·병원·의료진 간 책임 배분은 과제로 남았다.

items.title: FDA Clears Emerging AI Triage Software for Nine Findings on Abdominopelvic CT
items.excerpt: FDA cleared a2z Radiology's a2z-Omni-Triage, AI software for adjunctive triage of nine acute findings on abdominopelvic CT. (Off-list outlet: no on-list coverage found.)

items.title: FDA-Authorized AI/ML Tool for Sepsis Prediction: Development and Validation
items.excerpt: NEJM AI paper describing the development and validation of an FDA-authorized AI/ML sepsis prediction tool (Crossref created 2026-11-19; body not retrievable - verify details).

items.title: AI rules for doctors must include organisational responsibility
items.excerpt: BMJ correspondence responding to proposed rules for clinicians using AI: beyond individual clinical duties, healthcare organisations that place AI systems in clinical workflows must also assume responsibility (liability/governance angle; letter).

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Waystar integrates into Google Cloud's Gemini for healthcare; Oracle debuts AI agents for clinical trials
items.excerpt: Weekly health-tech brief: Oracle Life Science AI Agents for clinical-trial portfolio monitoring and planning; Amazon Connect Health adds agentic patient-access tasks (Temple Health handling thousands of verification calls weekly); Artera agentic intake; ChatGPT Health expands.
